test_title: PYST 30: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Sufficient
solution:
The correct answer is Meagre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Sufficient:** **enough​

 
 
• **Example**: The food is **sufficient** for all the people present in the wedding hall. 
 
 
 
• **Meagre**: lacking in quantity or quality.

 Hence, the antonym of** sufficient** is **meagre**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Plentiful: abundant.
 
• Adequate: sufficient, enough.
 
• Ample: ​enough or more than enough; plentiful.
